headline: State Street’s $5.7 Trillion Portfolio Chief Missed Bitcoin at $500. But She Saw Gold’s $3,000 Run Coming Years Earlier
summary: State Street's $5.7 trillion portfolio chief built a thesis that proved right on one hard asset and catastrophically wrong on another, and the story of both calls reveals something uncomfortable about how even the best institutional minds handle paradigm-shifting money.
